summary: Defines a profile for proxy certificates, which are X.509 certificates signed by an ordinary end-user certificate rather than by a certificate authority. They let a user delegate limited rights to a program or process without sharing their private key. This is useful for single sign-on across systems.

eli5.summary: You sign a note saying your helper may do a few chores for you today. The note expires soon, so you never hand over your real keys.
